title: National Theatre of Costa Rica
scope: The standing historic National Theatre building in San José, including its foyer, auditorium and stage-house exteriors.
limitations: This models the durable main theatre exterior and original architectural organization. Detached ticket offices, fences and movable interiors are outside the model scope.
Stone coloration, individual reliefs, roof fittings and the profiles of the restored replicas are approximated at landmark resolution. Mapzen terrain captures the site grade at provider grid spacing.
